You felt that jolt earlier, didn't you? He went straight back to his room,
and he's been there ever since."
Yamato: "O-Oh. I-I-I wonder what could be wrong?"
That's the reaction of someone who knows something."
All right. Everyone, come with me."
We're going to the captain's cabin."
Ymir: "You can't even tell your big sister?"
Ymir: "...Fine. In any case, you clearly know
something, and we need the captain to come out.
Touya: 'Yeah. Maybe he was just taking a nap?'
Ymir: "Oh, Captain. It's about time... Captain?
Is something wrong? Has something happened?
Yamato: 'Not at all. He looks the same as always to me...'
Ymir: "...Oh! That's the model you were making,
Captain... Did that jolt earlier break it?"
Ymir: "...I see. So that's what happened."
Ymir: "...Now, then. Melvi, you and Gen were
Ymir: "That explains why you've been acting so strangely.
Why didn't you tell me the truth?"
Yamato: 'Hey, isn't she keeping quiet because we told her
not to say anything...? She thinks we'll be held responsible too
I'm the one who told her to keep quiet.
Touya: "Besides, the one who broke it was..."
Gen: "...It was me. I told her to keep quiet.
Gen: "Besides, the one who broke it was..."
Ymir: "...Melvi. The captain says he's going to repair the model ship
that broke in that jolt, and he'd like you to come help later."
Touya: "He's going to let it go...?"
Ymir: "Well, Captain, it's time to go to the bridge..."
